sites.behavior: Search works end to end for automated access: fill the input, press Enter, extract results.
sites.tactic: Preferred engine for search tasks. Start here.

sites.behavior: Article pages render statically and fully under headless; body paragraphs extract without login or delays.
sites.tactic: Reliable for content extraction. Extract paragraphs directly, no special handling needed.

sites.behavior: Public repository pages render fully under headless without login; titles and page content extract cleanly.
sites.tactic: Reliable for reading public repos and issues. Some interactive counters need JS settle time; wait briefly before extracting.

sites.behavior: Video pages render fully under headless without login: title, play counts and page text extract cleanly. URLs redirect to a trailing-slash form on load.
sites.tactic: Wait for the initial redirect and navigation to settle (about 3s) before evaluating; content is public, login is only needed for HD video.

sites.behavior: Front page and item pages are plain HTML and extract instantly under headless; no anti-automation signals observed.
sites.tactic: Reliable for headline and discussion extraction.

sites.behavior: Search triggers a CAPTCHA for automated access.
sites.tactic: Do not retry. Switch to Bing and mention the switch in the final answer.

sites.behavior: Served a human-verification challenge instead of results for automated search on both the standard and html endpoints; under headless the homepage search input may also never appear. Control run: Bing answered on the same network path, so this is a site fact.
sites.tactic: Treat as unavailable for autonomous search: use Bing instead. If DuckDuckGo is required, hand the challenge to the user to complete manually.

sites.behavior: The home search input is invisible under headless mode (anti-automation).
sites.tactic: Switch to Bing; if Baidu is required, ask the user to set PW_HEADLESS=false and restart DSH, or let the user complete the step manually.

sites.behavior: Question pages serve a Cloudflare-style 'please wait' interstitial that did not clear after a 10-second wait under headless; challenges are probabilistic and depend on IP reputation.
sites.tactic: If the interstitial persists past a 10-second wait, stop and hand the page to the user, or extract the answer from an alternative source.

sites.behavior: Package pages serve a Cloudflare-style 'please wait' interstitial under headless on this network path, same protection family as Stack Overflow.
sites.tactic: If the interstitial persists past a 10-second wait, stop and hand the page to the user, or get package facts from the registry API instead.

sites.behavior: Question requests are rejected with an anomaly JSON error (code 40362, 'requests look abnormal, access temporarily limited') instead of the page; restriction is probabilistic and IP/behavior dependent.
sites.tactic: Do not retry the same request. Fall back to another source, or let the user log in and complete the step manually.

sites.behavior: Search page loads but product results are withheld with a rate-limit notice ('search unavailable due to frequent access') under automated access; probabilistic, works again after waiting.
sites.tactic: Do not hammer retries. Wait and retry once; if still limited, ask the user to search manually in their browser.

sites.behavior: Search results stay behind a login wall without an account: the page renders but results never finish loading, showing a sign-in prompt.
sites.tactic: Do not loop on the loading page. Ask the user to log in (or search manually); login is a human step.
